items.title: Duterte camp to ICC: Exclude recorded testimony of ex-DDS
items.description: The defense team of former president Rodrigo Duterte has urged the trial judges of the International Criminal Court (ICC) to exclude the recorded testimony of a former police officer who claimed to be a former member of the so-called Davao death squad.

items.title: Gatchalian lauds JV for weeding out P97 billion ‘non-compliant’ projects
items.description: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian lauded finance committee chairman Sen. JV Ejercito for being stricter than him in handling the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027, which saw P97.5 billion in public works projects excised for being non-compliant.

items.title: Senate impeach court set to take short break
items.description: The Senate impeachment court will go on a brief hiatus this week, with trial sessions set to resume on Dec. 1, as the tribunal targets a final judgment before Congress adjourns on Dec. 18.

items.title: Tree-planting drive and Cale88: No link, says OVP
items.description: The Office of the Vice President maintained that its nationwide tree-planting program has no connection with Cale88 Foods Corp. after it was raised by the House prosecution team during the impeachment trial against VP Sara Duterte on Friday.

items.title: Bullies face expulsion under new rules, says DepEd chief

items.title: DOTr eyes removal of barriers at tollways
items.description: The Department of Transportation will pilot the removal of barriers across expressways in the country to eliminate bottlenecks at toll plazas and reduce motorists’ travel time, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon announced yesterday.
